soc.promotion_relegation_playoff_bracket.rationale: Promotion series settle on being promoted by any route, so ranks 3-8 (EFL Championship from 2026-27) or 3-6 (Segunda) carry probability through a short knockout: the format decides how much rank matters. For 2026-27 a secondary web search reports a six-team EFL Championship play-off for 3rd-8th (round structure, hosts and tie-break not verified from primary text; final format reported as pending); if there is an early round that 3rd and 4th skip, 5th-8th face an extra gate of roughly 50% (an estimate, not sourced). In Segunda a level tie after extra time is reported by secondary sources to go to the better-placed side, which would tilt every tie toward the higher seed with no shootout coin-flip; whether away goals or penalties play any role is unverified. Subtle: the Segunda reserve-team eligibility rule (filial sides) is unverified here and, if real, shifts which ranks qualify; formats change between seasons.
soc.promotion_relegation_playoff_bracket.measurement: Per competition-season, encode the format: entrant ranks, round structure, legs, host rule, away-goals (none in either), extra time and tie-break (EFL: ET then penalties assumed as default, unverified for the 2026-27 format; Segunda: ET then higher regular-season rank per secondary sources, remaining rules unverified). For each simulated final table, simulate each tie with team goal rates from the as-of ratings: single legs via soc.extra_time_shootout_model at the higher seed's venue, two-leg ties via soc.tie_advancement_state_tree (second leg at the higher seed), Segunda ties replacing the shootout branch with P=1 for the higher seed if the better-placed-side rule is confirmed from the regulations. P(promoted_i) = sum over simulated tables of [rank_i automatic] + [rank_i in play-off] x P(win bracket | bracket draw). Calibrate P(win bracket | seed) against 20 seasons of EFL and Segunda play-off results (Wilson intervals, shrink to the simulation with k=10 seasons). As-of: format rules published before the season; ratings as of the pricing timestamp.
